Maya (PM): Heads up — we need a final pass on the PRD acceptance criteria for audit logs + keying for launch. SOC2/ISO gates are blocking next week's review. Can folks weigh in on retention and KMS/HSM expectations by EOD?

Priya (Compliance): For SOC2 we need 1 year of immutable audit logs plus access audit for crypto ops. ISO might ask for 2 years depending on customer. We should default to 1y with opt-in 2y.

Jin (Security): Agree. KMS = required for hosted and dedicated. For Private we can accept customer-managed HSM/KMS; we need a clear API for key rotation and proof of key lineage. HSM requirement only for customers with regulatory needs.

Carlos (Eng): Implementation note: storing immutable logs means WORM S3 + signed digests. We can support 1y retention cheaply; 2y doubles storage. Also need to define redaction rules for PII (PII should never be stored in plaintext logs).

Lena (SecEng): Edge case: keys rotated/deleted — we must preserve decryptability of logs used as evidence. Store enveloped data or key-wrapping metadata. Include acceptance test: restore-playback of an auth event using key lineage.

Maya (PM): Good. Proposing acceptance criteria snippet:

```
- Audit logs: WORM storage enabled; daily digests signed; retention default 365d; retention configurable up to 1095d per customer.
- Access logs: token-level access entries for any crypto ops, retained 365d.
- KMS: Managed KMS by Redwood for hosted/dedicated; bring-your-own-key (BYOK) support for Private via KMS/HSM; key rotation supported, rotation events logged.
- HSM: Optional for Private; for enterprise SKUs HSM-backed root key required.
- Evidence: ability to produce signed log bundle + key lineage within 48h.
- Tests: automated retention enforcement test, key-rotation roundtrip test, redaction verification.
```

Priya (Compliance): Add: documentation for retention exceptions and legal holds. And an API meta-field `retention_policy` on customer config.

Carlos (Eng): Dev note: needs schema change and UI flag. Also cost/ops: add a ticket for storage estimate to finance.

deploy-bot: Reminder — RFC doc updated at https://redwood/docs/rfc/kms-logs-v2 (link).

Maya (PM): Thanks — I'll update PRD and tag owners. Action items: Carlos to spec implementation plan by Fri, Jin/Lena to draft key lineage proof steps, Priya to draft compliance text. @channel if no objections we'll lock acceptance criteria tomorrow.
